name: Goodbudget
description: Goodbudget is an envelope-budgeting app for planning spending, sharing a household budget, and tracking accounts and transactions across web and mobile devices. People use it to divide income among virtual envelopes and coordinate everyday financial decisions with family members.
agentUseSummary: Goodbudget does not publish a supported third-party household API, so Relay does not collect household credentials, call private sync endpoints, or expose agent actions.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is offered without a provider-supported third-party API contract.

runtimeSupport.description: Goodbudget has no documented third-party account API for a bounded Relay connector.
Goodbudget has no documented third-party account API for a bounded Relay connector.

providerSetup.blocker: Goodbudget's official product and support surfaces do not publish a developer application, delegated authorization flow, account API, or webhook contract for third-party access.
providerSetup.nextAction: Reassess only if Goodbudget publishes an official third-party developer program and documented authorization and account-data APIs.

evidence.supports: Goodbudget presents a consumer envelope-budgeting product for household planning, syncing, and transaction tracking.
Goodbudget's official help resources document the customer product; they do not publish a third-party developer application, authorization flow, or account API.
Goodbudget's changelog uses API to describe its internal web and mobile implementation, not a supported external integration contract.
